title: ravensara dealbata
intro: Ravensara dealbata, commonly known as Ravensara or Cananga, is a plant species native to Madagascar, belonging to the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to relieve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ravensara dealbata include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating respiratory and skin conditions. Ravensara dealbata contains bioactive constituents such as camphor, borneol, and bornyl acetate, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
